We have $$\int_{1}^{e} \frac{e^x}{x} (1 + x \log x) \, dx = \int_{1}^{e} e^x \left( \frac{1}{x} + \log x \right) dx.$$

Notice that $\frac{d}{dx} (e^x \log x) = e^x \log x + e^x \cdot \frac{1}{x} = e^x \left( \frac{1}{x} + \log x \right)$.

Thus the integral becomes:
$$\left[ e^x \log x \right]_{1}^{e} = e^e \log e - e^1 \log 1 = e^e \cdot 1 - e \cdot 0 = e^e.$$

Hence the correct option is A: $e^e$.
